title: Custom link card
question: Clicking a link opens the edit side panel, and the destination field will pre-select what’s already saved. Which destination wording should the card use?

options.label: Opens
options.thesis: Card reads “Opens Friday Social” — guests know what the short URL lands on.
options.viewport: Name + URL on the card; one line “Opens · Friday Social” with Event/Series chip.
options.risk: Slightly casual if someone expects admin jargon.

options.label: Sends guests to
options.thesis: Card reads “Sends guests to Friday Social” — frames the organiser’s job as directing people.
options.viewport: Same card anatomy; destination line leads with “Sends guests to”.
options.risk: Longer line truncates earlier on phones.

options.label: Destination
options.thesis: Card labels the field “Destination” then the event name — admin-clear, no metaphor.
options.viewport: Muted “Destination” label beside the event name and type chip.
options.risk: Slightly colder than the rest of the organiser hub voice.
